title: BMM
tagline: Static HTML site for a BMM brief — public, small, and honest about its scope.
overview: BMM is a small public HTML site (with a related BMM_HW homework repo). It is a web-fundamentals artifact, not a product platform.
problem: Needed a shareable static page for a course/homework brief without a JS framework.
solution: Hand-authored HTML/CSS in a public repo, plus the homework companion.
architecture: Static HTML documents. No build step.
challenges: Keeping the portfolio listing honest about scale
lessonsLearned: Not every public repo needs a twelve-section case study
futureImprovements: Leave it as a fundamentals snapshot
results: Public static site still available on GitHub
